settings.label: Default social sharing image
settings.info: Shown when your homepage or a page without its own image is shared on WhatsApp, Instagram or Facebook. 1200 × 630 px works best.

settings.content: Enter these once. They are used in the floating contact button, the footer, product pages, collection pages and the contact page.

settings.label: WhatsApp number
settings.info: With country code, e.g. 923001234567. Spaces, + and dashes are removed automatically.

settings.content: Store credit itself is granted in Shopify admin by a Flow workflow on customer creation. These settings only control what the storefront says about it.

settings.label: Show welcome credit messaging
settings.info: Only changes what the storefront says. The credit itself is granted by a Shopify Flow workflow in admin (see WELCOME-CREDIT-SETUP.md). Confirm a real signup receives both the balance and the tag before relying on this.

settings.label: Amount shown to new visitors
settings.info: Written out as shoppers should read it, e.g. Rs. 500. Signed-in customers see their real balance instead.

settings.label: Customer tag set when credit is granted
settings.info: Must match the tag your Flow workflow adds. Without it a zero balance cannot be told apart from credit that has not arrived yet.

settings.content: Shows a message when stock is low. Only works for products where Shopify tracks stock and “Continue selling when out of stock” is off. Exact stock counts are never shown above the threshold, and never sent to the browser.

settings.label: Show “Only X left” on product pages
Show “Few left” on product cards
settings.info: Cards appear in collections and on the homepage.

settings.label: Show when this many or fewer are left
